storyCards.headline: Love Stinks: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
The J. Geils Band's "Love Stinks" reached #38 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Love Stinks" is a song written by Peter Wolf and Seth Justman that was the title track of the J.

The song was released as a single and peaked in the U.S.

The song peaked at #38 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Love Stinks was released in 1980.
